reproducibility.correlationSql:
with selected_runs as (
  select r.* from public.source_runs r
  where r.trigger_run_id = any (array['run_06glnirsvhqdmbeiiur94st901']::text[])
), linked_evidence as (
  select r.id as run_id, count(c.id)::integer as capture_count,
    coalesce(sum(c.byte_count),0)::bigint as captured_bytes,
    count(o.id)::integer as stored_object_count,
    count(c.id) filter (where o.id is not null and (o.metadata->>'size') ~ '^\d+$' and (o.metadata->>'size')::bigint=c.byte_count)::integer as matching_object_byte_counts,
    bool_and(c.storage_path is not null and c.purged_at is null)::boolean as raw_reference_available,
    min(c.fetched_at) as first_capture_fetched_at, max(c.fetched_at) as last_capture_fetched_at
  from selected_runs r
  left join public.run_captures rc on rc.run_id=r.id and rc.owner_id=r.owner_id
  left join public.captures c on c.id=rc.capture_id and c.owner_id=rc.owner_id
  left join storage.objects o on o.bucket_id='captures' and o.name=c.storage_path
  group by r.id
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'checked_at',clock_timestamp(),
  'bucket_private',coalesce((select not public from storage.buckets where id='captures'),false),
  'registered_owner_count',(select count(*) from public.tracker_members),
  'enabled_source_count',(select count(*) from public.sources where enabled),
  'runs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'source_run_id',r.id,'source_id',r.source_id,
    'trigger_run_id',r.trigger_run_id,'trigger_schedule_id',r.trigger_schedule_id,'invocation_kind',r.invocation_kind,
    'dispatcher_scheduled_at',r.dispatcher_scheduled_at,'scheduled_poll_at',r.scheduled_poll_at,
    'started_at',r.started_at,'finished_at',r.finished_at,'committed_at',r.created_at,
    'outcome',r.outcome,'pagination_complete',r.pagination_complete,'parser_version',r.parser_version,
    'http_status',r.http_status,'request_count',r.request_count,'byte_count',r.byte_count,
    'opportunity_observation_count',r.opportunity_count,'occurrence_observation_count',r.occurrence_count,
    'collection_window',r.collection_window,'error',r.error,'source_cost_usd',r.cost_usd,
    'evidence',to_jsonb(e)-'run_id'
  ) order by r.started_at,r.source_id) from selected_runs r join linked_evidence e on e.run_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'sources',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'source_id',s.id,'cadence_seconds',s.cadence_seconds,'health_status',s.health_status,
    'last_attempt_at',s.last_attempt_at,'last_success_at',s.last_success_at,'next_poll_at',s.next_poll_at,
    'retry_not_before',s.retry_not_before,'next_due_at',s.next_due_at,'active_lease',s.lease_until>clock_timestamp(),
    'opportunity_count',(select count(*) from public.opportunities o where o.source_id=s.id),
    'occurrence_count',(select count(*) from public.occurrences o where o.source_id=s.id)
  ) order by s.id) from public.sources s where s.enabled),'[]'::jsonb),
  'totals',jsonb_build_object(
    'opportunities',(select count(*) from public.opportunities),'occurrences',(select count(*) from public.occurrences),
    'captures',(select count(*) from public.captures),'source_runs',(select count(*) from public.source_runs),
    'entity_versions',(select count(*) from public.entity_versions),'field_claims',(select count(*) from public.field_claims),
    'storage_objects',(select count(*) from storage.objects where bucket_id='captures'),
    'duplicate_opportunity_identity_groups',(select count(*) from (select owner_id,source_id,native_id from public.opportunities group by owner_id,source_id,native_id having count(*)>1) d),
    'duplicate_occurrence_identity_groups',(select count(*) from (select owner_id,source_id,native_id from public.occurrences group by owner_id,source_id,native_id having count(*)>1) d)
  )
) as correlation;
reproducibility.captureMetadataSql: select r.id as source_run_id,r.source_id,c.id as capture_id,c.native_id,c.content_sha256,c.content_type,c.byte_count,c.first_seen_at,c.fetched_at,c.retention_until,c.purged_at is null as raw_available,o.id is not null as stored_object_exists,case when (o.metadata->>'size') ~ '^\d+$' then (o.metadata->>'size')::bigint else null end as stored_object_metadata_bytes from public.source_runs r join public.run_captures rc on rc.run_id=r.id and rc.owner_id=r.owner_id join public.captures c on c.id=rc.capture_id and c.owner_id=rc.owner_id left join storage.objects o on o.bucket_id='captures' and o.name=c.storage_path where r.trigger_run_id='run_06glnirsvhqdmbeiiur94st901' order by r.source_id,c.native_id;
